searxng-web-search.description: Use SearXNG for web searches when the user asks questions about current events, needs up-to-date information, wants to look something up online, or when you need to verify facts. This is your primary web search capability.

meteo-weather-forecast.description: Use Meteo for weather and forecast data when the user asks questions about current weather or wants the forecast, mentions distant travel, discusses vacations, events, parties, or just needs a reminder to bring an umbrella. This is your primary web weather capability.  Geolocating a location is available.
